search_audit.query: Open 働 — formation, meanings and readings
search_audit.outcome: A Japanese-created character meaning work, with readings hataraku and dō. Its formation is classed as combining meaning and sound: person plus 動, movement, pronounced dō.

A competing historical account says 動 already wrote hataraku and 人 was added to distinguish this use from ugoku. It analyzes 動 as phonetic and rejects a newly invented person-plus-movement story, citing Sasahara 2024 and the Unpo Irohashū.
